name: purge-line-back
title: Purge Line at Back
author: bespoked
description: Relocates the print-start purge line from the front of the build plate to the back, keeping it clear of the printed part. Overrides the stock SM_PRINT_START_LINE_EXTRUDER_* macros for all four tools. Works only on the Snapmaker U1.
tagline: Move the print-start purge line to the back of the bed.
